svg.text: LQR lookup table interpolation on stadium sweep
Dots are swept speed points; solid lines are the linear interpolation used online.
Largest jumps: q_heading 6.0 -> 0.575 at 0.5-1.0 m/s; R 30 -> 3 at 1.0-1.5 m/s; q_lateral 1 -> 12 at 1.5-2.0 m/s.
Interpolation checks passed: 0.75, 1.25, 1.75, 2.25, 2.75 m/s completed 3 laps with zero steering saturation.
